title: Version 1.5.0
body:
Version 1.5.0

April 8th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added egg event!
  • Added egg currency
  • Added new bunny NPC
  • Added 2 new spring gifts
  • Added 3 new spring items

Changes:

  • Decreased price of 'pillow'
  • Bans now show their reason

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed sign text bug
  • Fixed price in Robux purchases being wrong
  • Fixed a blueprint image being reversed in the schematic store

Version 1.5.1

April 8th, 2023

Changes:

  • NPC now says how long until the next hunt
  • Hunt interval is now 10 minutes instead of 15

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issues with unboxing structures
  • Fixed issues with purchasing egg-related goods

Version 1.5.2

April 21st, 2023

Changes:

  • Changed more safety checks for eggs

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed base loading glitch/exploit
